title: Not Flannel In Typical Sense But OK
text: Not Flannel In Typical Sense But OK. These are nice, warm and comfortable. Made in Pakistan. To say these are flannel is a stretch because they border somewhere between flannel and regular cotton sheets. I'd recommend for regular sheets but not flannel sheets.

product_metadata.title: Laura Ashley Crestwood Sheet, King, Bristol Paisley
features: King set includes flat sheet, fitted sheet, 2 king pillowcases
description: Laura Ashley Flannel Sheet sets are 100-Percent brushed cotton for added softness. They are pre-shrunk, so you don't have to worry about shrinkage. Each set includes 2 pillowcases (1 with twin size) flat sheet and fitted sheet. Cuddle up with these signature Laura Ashley prints and enjoy a beautiful nights sleep.
